primary_source.title: An Exceptionally Simple Theory of Everything
primary_source.author: A. Garrett Lisi
primary_source.original_scope: Four real Higgs components forming a vector of Cl(4), proposed electroweak so(4) role

source_clifford.carrier: Cl(4) positive Euclidean signature, not earlier gravitational Cl(3,1)
source_clifford.source_vector: phi = sum_{mu=1}^4 phi^mu gammaPrime_mu; phi^1,phi^2,phi^3,phi^4 are real independent source components
distinct_binders: mu ranges 1..4 and is summed in phi^mu*gammaPrime_mu
eps ranges 1..3 and is summed in Pauli spatial block
4-by-4 rows are source spinor matrix output, columns input; Higgs doublet (phiPlus,phiZero) is not a 4-by-4 spinor column
source_clifford.dangerous_identity: phiOne is NOT the real field coefficient phi^1; phiOne is a distinct complex source Higgs label formed from phi^3 and phi^4
source_reality_conditions: phi^1..phi^4 are four real fields; arbitrary complex phi^mu are outside the stated source scope
preserved_modalities: The source says it is sensible to CONSIDER the four real Higgs fields as a vector of so(4), not that this alone proves the full proposed E8 dynamics.
The source's electroweak W and B1 gauge fields act on different fermion chiralities; they must not be identified.
The source's so(4)=su(2)L+su(2)R is a Lie algebra decomposition; global Spin/SO group isomorphism is not asserted by this specific formula.

finite_positive_checks: Exact Gamma' Pauli products and all 16 ordered generator anticommutators
All 81 real phi^mu tuples have exact source Higgs matrix entries, using source phi labels not conventional label guessing
Phi matrix is Hermitian in the real source domain: Phi^dagger=Phi
finite_scope.historical_real_form_warning: L01's separately printed real SL(2,C)=SL(2,R)xSL(2,R) group assertion already has a finite center/Killing counterexample and is not repaired by Cl(4) source success.

unresolved.electroweak_connection: L01 §2.2.2 printed wew su(2)L+su(2)R block and its V,U coefficient transport/2.9 rotation require separate typed source audit; not inferred from Phi representation.
unresolved.Cartan_and_weights: L01 source electroweak Cartan matrix, Table 4 source weighted charge/hypercharge, matching of two D2 sectors and subsequent Cl(7,1) generators remain unresolved.

next_lawful_step: Independently calculate gammaPrime, source labeled Higgs field four-by-four, 16 Cl4 anticommutators and all 81 real phi tuples with mutation tests. Admit only G0 source partial evidence into L-SSC-031 successor after a passing baseline; no G1/G7 or unreviewed electroweak dynamics.
